weather.summary: Chance Rain Showers then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: A 40 percent chance of showers, then a heat index near 106. Go early.

air.blurb: Cleanest air in days. The heat, not the air, is what limits you today.

lake.blurb: Still close to full, down a touch from last week. Good news for the fall.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 84,500 megawatts, with 107,500 on hand.

sun.blurb: Daylight holds until nearly eight. There is an evening in there after the heat breaks.
